AR-2026F-SB31.aiSummary: This bill would fund the Arkansas Administrative Office of the Courts for fiscal year 2026-2027. It sets staff levels and pays for court operations, interpreter services, judicial education, dispute resolution, hearing and vision aids for jurors, district judge training, and dependency-neglect representation. The bill sets out a total of several appropriations for these programs, including $7,216,024 for operations and $8,669,335 for dependency-neglect representation.

AR-2026F-HB1024.aiSummary: The act gives money for the Arkansas Department of Parks, Heritage, and Tourism, Division of Heritage, for the 2026-2027 fiscal year. It sets staff limits and funding for shared services, state operations, conservation tax work, and the Delta Cultural Center. It also sets money for pay, extra help, travel, grants, building work, and other operating costs.
